business.what: Deepak Nitrite Ltd is a leading integrated chemical intermediates company with a comprehensive portfolio spanning Advanced Intermediates and Phenolics. It makes money by manufacturing and selling a wide range of chemical products across domestic and global markets for diverse industrial applications.

segments.name: Advanced Intermediates
segments.detail: Generated a revenue of ₹ 2,553 Crores with an EBIT of ₹ 107 Crores in FY 2025-26.

segments.name: Phenolics
segments.detail: Generated a revenue of ₹ 5,401 Crores with an EBIT of ₹ 695 Crores in FY 2025-26.

strategy: Expansion into Speciality and performance chemicals

narrative.read: Deepak Nitrite has seen a sharp operational acceleration in FY27, with Q2 FY27 revenue reaching ₹3,076 crore and operating margin expanding to 20%, up from 13% in FY26. However, annual cash from operations dropped to ₹539 crore in FY26 while capex reached ₹1,197 crore, highlighting cash flow pressure amid aggressive capital expenditure plans.

promises.promise: Favourable performance expected in Q4 FY26
promises.delivered: Q4 FY26 sales increased to ₹2,120 crore (vs ₹1,975 crore in Q3 FY26), OPM expanded to 18% (vs 11%), and net profit doubled to ₹220 crore.
promises.quote: With this positive backdrop, the Group expects a favourable performance in Q4 FY26.

promises.promise: Commissioning of MIBK/MIBC project within Q3 FY26
promises.delivered: In the subsequent Q4 FY26 call, management delayed the commissioning target to the tail end of Q1 or early part of Q2 FY27.
promises.quote: The MIBK/ MIBC project is progressing well and is targeted for commissioning within this quarter.

promises.promise: Nitric acid, nitration, and hydrogenation utilization running at 95% to 100% from Q3 FY26
promises.delivered: Management reported in the Q4 FY26 call that nitric acid plant utilization was constrained to about 45% during Q4 due to technical issues.
promises.quote: Now on the nitric acid investment, on the nitration and on the hydrogenation, we are expecting to run at 100% or close enough to 100% utilization from this quarter onwards. They may be between 95% to 100%, 105%.

promises.promise: Commissioning of MIBK and MIBC asset by tail end of Q1 or early Q2 FY27
promises.delivered: Product-specific commissioning dates and asset performance are not detailed in the financial table.
promises.quote: at some point, maybe perhaps at the tail end of Q1 or the early part of Q2 is when we will be looking at commissioning of the asset

promises.promise: Commissioning of integrated polycarbonate project by June 2028
promises.delivered: Horizon date of June 2028 has not yet arrived.
promises.quote: we are expecting it to be commissioned by June 2028.

promises.promise: Spend an additional ₹1,000 crore to ₹1,500 crore on capex in FY27
promises.delivered: Full year FY27 cash flow and capex figures are not yet reported in the annual table.
promises.quote: Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.

narrative.credibility: Management successfully delivered on its short-term Q4 FY26 earnings target but missed initial timelines and utilization guidance for its MIBK and nitric acid facilities.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Management anticipated favourable performance in Q4 FY26.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Q4 FY26 revenue grew to ₹2,120 crore from ₹1,975 crore sequentially, with operating profit rising from ₹211 crore to ₹376 crore and OPM improving to 18%.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Management reported best-ever operating history performance with record Revenue and EBITDA in Q2 FY27.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026) revenue hit a record ₹3,076 crore and operating profit reached ₹627 crore at a 20% OPM, outperforming all prior quarters in the table.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Strategic execution is backed by value chain integration and cash generation strength.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Cash from operations steadily dropped from ₹874 crore in FY24 to ₹539 crore in FY26, even as annual capex rose from ₹764 crore to ₹1,197 crore.

bull: Quarterly financial trajectory showed substantial expansion in FY27, with sales growing to ₹3,076 crore and operating profit hitting ₹627 crore in Sep 2026.
OPM expanded from 10% in Jun 2025 to 21% in Jun 2026 and 20% in Sep 2026, demonstrating operating leverage.
TTM net profit reached ₹1,062 crore, recovering strongly from ₹551 crore in FY26.
bear: Cash flow from operations weakened to ₹539 crore in FY26 from ₹874 crore in FY24, worsening free cash flow generation during high capex spend.
Annual capex elevated significantly to ₹1,197 crore in FY26 with heavy multi-year capex targets planned through FY29.
Execution hiccups surfaced in core projects, including technical issues limiting nitric acid plant utilization to ~45% in Q4 FY26 and delaying MIBK commissioning.
askManagement: What specific technical bottlenecks limited nitric acid plant utilization to 45% in Q4 FY26, and what is its current operating rate?
Given that cash flow from operations fell to ₹539 crore in FY26 while FY28 capex is targeted at ₹2,200–2,400 crore, what is the planned funding structure?
How much of the revenue increase to ₹3,076 crore in Q2 FY27 was driven by higher spreads in Phenolics versus volume ramp-ups in Advanced Intermediates?
